about.en: OTC is the token of OTC Desks, a Solana project that describes itself as an "everything protocol", building and shipping whatever on-chain product is drawing volume and attention on Solana at the time rather than committing to a single product line. The token is a Solana SPL token whose mint authority has been revoked, and it trades on centralized venues including MEXC. It is a speculative community token, not a claim on any off-chain asset or security.
